title: Lavon approves 90-day moratorium on potential data center projects
scope: New source version recovered after first QA application; not an automatic canonical correction.
finding: The syndicated WFAA body reports unanimous approval and a 90-day term, but also conditions official approval on a second reading in mid-November. Its August 7 UTC publication metadata and Thursday reference do not establish an earlier operative August instrument. The chronology conflict requires adjudication; no new adoption date or force claim is accepted.
